lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is Wednesday's Board of County Commissioners meeting, where the county — sitting as the Housing Authority — is set to ratify a policy change at Pinion Park that would shift income eligibility to 80% AMI, quietly redrawing the line on who qualifies for a unit. That same day, Town of Telluride's Ecology Commission takes up a draft ordinance that would phase out combustion-powered lawn and garden equipment entirely, with leaf blowers banned by 2028. Tuesday's Town Council work sessions are also worth tracking, covering the Comprehensive Plan, a gondola subcommittee update, and a proposed third-party audit of rental housing policies.

notable.stake: Third-party audit of rent policy and Comprehensive Plan goals up for Council review.
